metadata.title: When I get 1 kill and Valorant’s like ‘Congrats, you’re a legend now’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just clutch without trying?
Enemy must’ve hit the invisible pause button.
Click if your aim’s a mess but you still get that lucky shot.
Valorant logic: still trolling pros and noobs alike.

Tap if your best plays feel like pure accident!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
